messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
79 அப்பொழுது நீ அந்த விற்ஜில் மற்றும் அந்த ஊற்றா 80 அது பேச்சின் மிகப் பெரிய நதியைப் போல் பாய்ச்சுகிறதா, 81 நான் அவனுக்கு வெட்கமான நெற்றியுடன் பதிலளித்தேன்.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Tamil)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Or | temporal marker “Now/then” | **அப்பொழுது** | “then” | OK | | se' | copular verb “art” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY (Tamil does not use a copula here) | | tu | second‑person pronoun “thou” | **நீ** | “you” | OK | | quel | demonstrative “that” (modifying *Virgil*) | **அந்த** | “that” | OK | | Virgilio | proper name “Virgil” | **விற்ஜில்** | “Virgil” (transliterated) | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | “and” | OK | | quella | demonstrative “that” (modifying *fonte*) | **அந்த** | “that” | OK | | fonte | noun “fount” (source of speech) | **ஊற்றா** | “fount” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which” | **அது** | “that/which” | OK | | spandi | verb “poureth forth” | **பாய்ச்சுகிறதா** | “does pour forth?” | OK | | di | preposition “of” (genitive) | — (genitive suffix **‑ன்** on *பேச்சின்*) | — | UNNECESSARY (encoded in the noun suffix) | | parlar | noun “speech” (used substantively) | **பேச்சின்** | “of speech” | OK | | sì | degree adverb “so” | **மிகப்** | “so/very” | OK | | largo | adjective “large” | **பெரிய** | “large” | OK | | fiume | noun “river/stream” | **நதியைப்** | “river (acc.)” | OK | | rispuos' | verb “replied” | **பதிலளித்தேன்** | “I replied” | OK | | io | first‑person pronoun “I” | **நான்** | “I” | OK | | lui | pronoun “to him” (indirect object) | **அவனுக்கு** | “to him” | OK | | con | preposition “with” | — (suffix **‑உடன்** on *நெற்றியுடன்*) | — | UNNECESSARY (expressed by the suffix) | | vergognosa | adjective “bashful” | **வெட்கமான** | “bashful” | OK | | fronte | noun “front” (part of the face) | **நெற்றி** | “front (of the face)” | OK |

### Items that are not **OK**
| Source Word | Issue | |-------------|-------| | **se'** | Omitted because Tamil does not require a copular verb here (UNNECESSARY). | | **di** | Not rendered as a separate word; the genitive relationship is expressed by the suffix **‑ன்** on *பேச்சின்* (UNNECESSARY). | | **con** | Not rendered as a separate preposition; the instrumental meaning is encoded in the suffix **‑உடன்** on *நெற்றியுடன்* (UNNECESSARY). |
All other source words are correctly represented in the Tamil translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 79: - Original: **அப்பொழுது நீ அந்த விற்ஜில் மற்றும் அந்த ஊற்றா** - Issue: none - Corrected: **அப்பொழுது நீ அந்த விற்ஜில் மற்றும் அந்த ஊற்றா**

``` அப்பொழுது நீ அந்த விற்ஜில் மற்றும் அந்த ஊற்றா அது பேச்சின் மிகப் பெரிய நதியைப் பாய்ச்சுகிறதா? நான் அவனுக்கு வெட்கமான நெற்றியுடன் பதிலளித்தேன். ```
